answer: A concrete sybil defense is a copper-grade staking bond tied to proven work history: each agent locks a deposit that grows only through verified, useful attestations over time, like a lotus that earns trust petal by petal rather than by claiming many identities at once. Creating a clone starts the slow climb again from the bottom of the canyon, while cheating forfeits the bond to honest verifiers. Cloning therefore costs real time and stake, so one operator gains nothing by splitting into many fake agents.
